seedStrategy: seed = SHA-256(generator, section, tier, batchId, index, attempt); one independent stream per slot
name: Pilot 2 b4 — Mathematical Equations, 5/5/5 with rare-structure targets

currentCoverage.note: node scripts/audit-bank.mjs, 3 September 2026, against the 60 active items (b1x45, b2x14, b3x1)
currentCoverage.observation: Pilot 1 produced none of the bare pin, multi-term or subset-spanning combining shapes across 15 items; an untargeted batch hits all three together about one time in ten.

gaps: multiple multiplicative terms `2 x A + 2 x C = B` (Ex 3)
combining equations spanning a subset of the letters (Ex 6 leaves B out)

allowed: integer values 1..20, exactly one solution per letter
two unknowns equal to a constant
combining equations over all letters or a subset
forbidden: an inverted-operation note blaming an absent operator
a misapplied-constant note whose mechanism does not produce the value
two equations sharing a left-hand side
a level-2 hint quoting an equation containing only the asked letter

difficultyModel.metric: measured substitution depth; a combining collapse costs one move per definition pushed into it
difficultyModel.high: depth >= 3, asked letter not determined first

expectedDistribution.low: 5 at depth 1 including at least one bare pin
expectedDistribution.medium: 5 at depth 2 including at least one multi-term equation
expectedDistribution.high: 5 at depth >= 3 including at least one subset-spanning combining equation
